cases.title: CDTEXTSEG puts the pipe label on the leg you click, even when the middle of the other leg is nearer the click
cases.plan_item: BUG-1194 CDTEXTSEG clicked leg (pilot-critical list 29 Oct 2026, entry 13; fix PR
cases.expected: A CE pipe made with CD E along 150000,-96000 / 170000,-96000 / 170000,-95000 (levels 18.000 and 17.800) has one label reading 'DIA.'. CDTEXTSEG with a click at 170000,-95500 (on the short leg) prints 'Pipe text moved.' and the label's x is above 168500 (beside the short leg). CDTEXTSEG again with a click at 169000,-96000 (on the long leg, 1 m from the bend) prints 'Pipe text moved.' and the label's x is below 166000 (beside the long leg). On the old rule the second click would keep the label on the short leg, because the short leg's middle is nearer that click. The drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The unit tests check the leg chooser on its own; only a live CDTEXTSEG shows that the real command passes the clicked point to it and moves the real label in the drawing.
not_automated: How the label looks (side, reading direction, clear of the line) is a Codex look; this case reads only which leg the label is beside, by its x.

The other three callers named in the fix (the CD and Edit Pipe 'move arrow AND text to that segment' question, and placing an arrow on a picked leg) are not driven; the CD question is answered with Esc as in R39.
A pipe between pits and a pipe with more than two legs are not driven. U after CDTEXTSEG is not driven.

cases.title: A pasted copy of a downpipe moved with MOVE leaves the original downpipe's label where it was, and the original's own MOVE still takes its label
cases.plan_item: BUG-1140 pasted downpipe and the original's label, MOVE half (pilot-critical list 29 Oct 2026, entry 12; fix PR
cases.expected: DP at 150000,-80000 prints 'Downpipe placed. Tag: DP' and adds one DOWNPIPE DYNAMIC WITH MASK block and one text on GUIDELINES (its label). The block alone is copied with COPYCLIP and pasted with PASTECLIP at 156000,-80000: one more DOWNPIPE DYNAMIC WITH MASK block appears. MOVE of the pasted copy by 0,3000 leaves the original block and the original label where they were (each within 1 mm). MOVE of the original by 0,2000 moves the original label by 2000 mm (within 1 mm). The drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The fix reads the label's owner note on the real objects; only a live paste and a live MOVE show which label the pasted downpipe drags.
not_automated: The CDREPAIR half of BUG-1140 is not driven: CDREPAIR opens the Drawing Repair window, which is not on the robot's read or press lists. It needs a Codex look.

A paste from ANOTHER drawing, a downpipe with a hitbox circle, and an old drawing whose labels carry no owner note are not driven. Whether the pasted copy gets a label of its own is recorded, not judged.
U after either MOVE is not driven.
